name: Acresuchus
sum: Medium-sized Late Miocene caiman from Acre, Brazil, and Venezuela, a close relative of the giant Purussaurus.
wsnote: A 2022 study estimated about 3.74 m and 260 kg from skull width; the holotype skull is about 51.5 cm long.
holotype: UFAC-2507 — a nearly complete skull, Solimões Formation, Acre, Brazil.
material: The holotype and several referred specimens, mostly from Niterói, Acre.
biology: Its skull is smaller than in all Purussaurus species, so it may be a transitional form between generalist caimans and Purussaurus.
author: Souza-Filho et al. 2019
